REPORT
Date January 30, 1941

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE Sp. Br. REGISTRY... 592 IN Shanghai //）

Subject January 28 Anniversary - activities.

Made by .................... and .................... Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

（批：J. Barrett 30/1/41 A.C. (S.B.)）

The anniversary of the January 28 Incident
(1932) passed off quietly. The following propaganda
literature of a National Salvation nature was
surreptitiously disseminated in various parts of
the Settlement :-

Literature Place of Distribution

1. Coloured paper slips Yu Yuen Road near Kiao-
bearing the slogan chow Road at 2.45 a.m.
reading "Celebrate 28/1/41 and also in other
the Anniversary by parts of the Settlement
contributing money later on the same day.
if one has money and
by rendering strength
if one has strength."

2. Coloured pamphlets Nanking Road near Yu
bearing on the anniversary Ya Ching Road at 10.55
and denouncing the issue p.m. 25/1/41.
of "bogus" banknotes
by the "traitors."

3. Paper slips purporting Yu Ya Ching Road near
to have been issued by Nanking Road at 4 p.m.
the No.5 Anti-Japanese 26/1/41.
Branch Corps, and
bearing different slogans
of the usual anti-
Japanese and anti-Wang
Ching Wei nature.

4. Mimeographed paper posters Avenue Road near Gordon
purporting to have been Road and Bubbling Well
issued by "Modern Road near Chengtu Road
Youth Propaganda on January 27, and 28.
Group" ( 時 青 宣 印 )
and bearing slogans of an
anti-Wang Ching Wei
nature.

5. Mimeographed handbill - do -
purporting to have been
issued by the "Kiangnan
Boiling Blood Anti-Japanese
Group" and containing a short
article urging the people in
Shanghai to support the
"Policy of Resistance and
National Re-construction."

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 31 JAN. 1941）

（印：DATE / MUNICIPAL REGISTRY / DATE 31 / 1 / 41）

(1932年) 的纪念日平静度过。以下具有救国性质的宣传
文献在租界各地被秘密散发：-

2. 纪念该周年并谴责“汉奸”发行“伪”钞的彩色小册子 1941年1月25日晚上10时55分在南京路附近的亚尔培路（今嵩山路）。

9TH ANNIVERSARY OF THE JANUARY 28 INCIDENT

The 9th anniversary of the Woosung-Shanghai War,
which falls on January 28, is fast approaching.
People in various walks of life are very much
impressed by the work of the officers and men at the front
on this big anniversary day in this year of victory.
However, owing to the special circumstances prevailing in
the Foreign Settlements, the residents will not hold any
ceremony to commemorate the event.

National Herald, Chinese-American Daily News, Cheng Yien Pao :-
NINTH ANNIVERSARY OF JANUARY 28 INCIDENT: ALL    27/1/41.
AMUSEMENTS TO BE SUSPENDED

To-morrow is the 9th anniversary of the
outbreak of Sino-Japanese hostilities in Woosung and
Shanghai area on January 28, 1932. In view of the fact
that the military operations in the present war of resistance
have entered the final stage of victory through the hard
struggle put up by the military and civilians throughout
the country during the past three years, the people in
various walks of life in Shanghai are feeling extremely
cheered up at the approach of this anniversary.
Despite the China New Year Holidays, local
people, in memory of the officers and men who sacrificed
their lives in the defence of their country, will suspend
all amusements and will not hold any ceremonies. They
will continue to do their bit by promoting the thrift,
conscience contributions and refugee relief movements.
In order to maintain peace and order in their
districts, the authorities of the two Foreign Settlements
will adopt special precautionary measures on January 28.

Cheng Yien Pao, Chinese-American Daily News, National Herald:

Local Celebrations on Spring Festival

January 27, 28 and 29 are Spring Festival
holidays. On the occasion of the New Year, the people
congratulate one another by saying "Happy New Year," but
the expression they now use is "Congratulations for
Victory."
The spring gifts movement will start from
February 10 as stipulated by the National Comfort
Association. The supreme leader has issued an address
advising the people to join the movement. The people in
this city will, according to custom, contribute the New
Year expenditure to the comfort funds.

P. T. O.

January 27, 1941.                                Morning Translation.

Last night was China New Year Eve; it was
also the eve of the January 28 Incident. At 9 p.m.
yesterday, a large number of patriotic young men were
found distributing slogans near the Wing On Company, the
New World Amusement Resort, the Great World Amusement
Resort, Carter Theatre, the Tse Shu Building (慈淑大楼),
the intersection of Avenue Edward VII and Fokien Road,
etc.

《国民新闻》、《中美日报》、《诚言报》:-
一·二八事变九周年：所有    1941年1月27日。
娱乐活动暂停

明天是1932年1月28日吴淞和上海地区中日敌对行动爆发的九周年纪念日。鉴于目前的抗战军事行动已通过全国军民过去三年的艰苦斗争进入胜利的最后阶段，上海各界人士在这一纪念日临近之际感到极为振奋。
尽管正值中国农历新年假期，当地民众为纪念为国捐躯的官兵，将暂停一切娱乐活动，且不举行任何仪式。他们将继续通过提倡节约、良心捐献和难民救济运动来尽一份力。
为了维持其辖区内的和平与秩序，两个外国租界的当局将在1月28日采取特别的预防措施。

《诚言报》、《中美日报》、《国民新闻》:

春节期间的本地庆祝活动

1月27日、28日和29日是春节假期。值此新年之际，人们互道“新年快乐”，但现在使用的表达是“恭喜胜利”。
根据全国慰劳总会规定，春礼运动将于2月10日开始。最高领袖已发表讲话，建议民众加入该运动。本市民众将按照习俗，将新年开支捐赠给慰劳基金。

下接后页。

1941年1月27日。                                晨间翻译。

昨晚是中国农历除夕；也是一·二八事变的前夕。昨晚9时，在永安公司、新世界游乐场、大世界游乐场、卡尔登戏院、慈淑大楼、爱多亚路（今延安东路）与福建路交叉口等地，发现大量爱国青年分发标语。

NO AMUSEMENTS ON 9TH ANNIVERSARY OF JANUARY 28 INCIDENT

The ninth anniversary of the January 28
Incident is approaching. In view of the conditions prevailing
in Shanghai, local residents will not hold any ceremony but
will voluntarily suspend all amusements on that day in memory
of the martyrs who lost their lives for the country.
The authorities of the two Foreign
Settlements will adopt special precautionary measures on that
day and will close all the less important roads on the
Settlement borders.

《诚言报》和《新晚报》:- 1941年1月31日。
（批注：此件打字一式三份。）
一·二八事变九周年无娱乐活动

一·二八事变九周年即将来临。鉴于上海目前的局势，当地居民将不举行任何仪式，但将在当日自愿暂停一切娱乐活动，以纪念为国捐躯的烈士。
两个外国租界的当局将在当日采取特别的预防措施，并关闭租界边界上所有次要道路。

January 21, 1941.

PRECAUTIONS TO BE ADOPTED ON JANUARY 23/28, 1941
CHINESE NEW YEAR AND THE ANNIVERSARY OF THE SINO/
JAPANESE INCIDENT (1932).
--------------------------------------------------

1. There is at present no indication that any organised
disturbance or demonstration will take on
January 28, 1941.
Owing to the incidence of Chinese New Year, these
instructions will cover both periods. Divisional
Officers will take precautions as considered
necessary.
The following are general instructions :-

SEARCH 2. Commencing from 6 p.m. January 23 internal search
PARTIES : parties consisting of all available uniform men
and detectives (including Headquarters details) will
round up and detain in Stations all known suspects,
loiterers, persons found in hotels, teashops and
lodging houses etc , who fail to give a satisfactory
account of their presence in the Settlement. Suspects
will be released at the discretion of Divisional Officers.

"BAUNG-PIAU" 3. The "Baung-Piau" Alarm system will be utilised in case
ALARMS : of any emergency considered likely to affect other
districts.
Practice Alarms during the emergency period will be
ordered by D.C. (Divisions). Intensive searching
will take place during practice alarms.

CURFEW : 4. Curfew will be strictly enforced during the period
January 23 to January 28, inclusive, and all cabarets
and places of amusement will be so informed. Shroffs
engaged on business during the nights of January 24/27
will not be unduly detained. Curfew passes found in
possession of persons found abusing the privilege will
be confiscated and forwarded to F.A. (Crime) together
with details regarding the circumstances.

1941年1月23/28日应采取的预防措施
中国农历新年及中日事变（1932年）纪念日。
--------------------------------------------------

1. 目前没有任何迹象表明1941年1月28日会发生有组织的骚乱或示威。
由于恰逢中国农历新年，本指令将涵盖这两个时期。各区警官将视需要采取预防措施。
以下为一般指令：-

搜查 2. 从1月23日下午6时开始，内部搜查
小组： 由所有可用的制服警员和侦探（包括总部特派人员）组成的搜查小组，将围捕并拘押在巡捕房内所有已知的嫌疑人、闲逛者、以及在旅馆、茶馆和寄宿房屋等处被发现且无法对其在租界内的存在给出满意解释的人员。嫌疑人的释放由各区警官酌情决定。

“邦票” 3. 如果发生被认为可能影响其他地区的紧急情况，将启用
警报： “邦票”警报系统。
紧急期间的演习警报将由各区副总监下令。演习警报期间将进行密集搜查。

宵禁： 4. 1月23日至1月28日（含）期间将严格执行宵禁，并通知所有歌舞厅和娱乐场所。1月24/27日晚间从事业务的收银员不会被过度扣留。发现滥用特权者持有的宵禁通行证将被没收，连同有关情况的细节一并送交财务审计处（犯罪科）。

JAPANESE
SUBJECTS : 10. Warning is being issued through the Japanese Author-
ities for Japanese residents to remain North of the

S. 1. Special Br.
REPORT
Date January 18, 1941.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SP. BR. REGISTRY No. 592）

Subject January 28th Anniversary - possible happenings.

M...h 18 and Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

S.C (Sinensis)
in forma alia
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE ...）

There is no indication that propaganda activities on a large scale will be conducted in the Settlement and French Concession. The local Chinese community will refrain from conducting any movement to commemorate the anniversary. Schools are closed for the winter vacation and the majority of the students have returned to their homes for the holidays. Chinese public bodies and refugee camps do not intend carrying out any form of propaganda work. It is however expected that the surreptitious dissemination of propaganda literature of a national salvation nature may take place on the day in question.

C. Crawford
D. I.

A. C. (Special Branch).

目前没有迹象表明会在租界和法租界进行大规模的宣传活动中。当地华人社区将 refrain from 开展任何纪念该周年的运动。学校因寒假停课，大多数学生已回家度假。华人公共团体和难民营不打算进行任何形式的宣传工作。然而，预计在那一天可能会秘密散发具有救国性质的宣传文献。

C. Crawford
